lines.en: Oleg, look. This is my friend.

lines.ru: Кто он? Я его не знаю.
lines.en: Who is he? I do not know him.

lines.ru: Он сейчас живёт в большой стране.
lines.en: He lives in a big country now.
Which country?
He did not say.
What do you think?

lines.ru: Думаю, он там стал новый человек.
lines.en: I think he has become a new person there.
New? How so?
He says there is big work there.

lines.ru: А ты, Катя? Ты хочешь так?
lines.en: And you, Katya? Do you want that?
I do not know. Everyone of mine is here.

lines.ru: При мне он был не такой.
lines.en: When I knew him he was not like that.
Not like what?
He was always thinking.
Yes. He is still like that.
He is your friend. I know that.

options: In the same town as them

questions.ask: What does Katya think has happened to him?
options: He has fallen out with her
He has forgotten all of it

questions.ask: What does Oleg remember about him?

options: The man is still her friend
The man was never her friend

lines.ru: Борис, когда ты первый раз тут был?
lines.en: Boris, when were you first here?
Many years ago. I was on my own.
And what did you see?
A big town. Plenty of work.
And what did you think?
That here I would become someone new.
And did you?
I do not know. This is my life.
You have lived here many years.
Yes. Work all day.
And when are you not working?
An hour, Nina. One hour.
One hour! That is not a life.
I think about it a lot.

lines.ru: Скажи одно слово. Что ты хочешь?
lines.en: Say one word. What do you want?
Time. I want time.

questions.ask: What did he find when he arrived?
options: A big town, and lots of work
A small town, and no work at all
A place he already knew well
Nothing that he liked at all

questions.ask: What did he expect to happen?
options: That he would be someone new
That he would go home again
That he would make money fast
That he would not stay long

questions.ask: How much time to himself does he have?
What does he say he wants?
